description_en: Queries the details of an Express Connect failover test job
description_zh: 调用DescribeFailoverTestJob接口查询高速通道故障演练任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-failover-test-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-id ftj-bp1yh6mvi13aq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFailoverTestJob

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the failover test job. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
故障演练任务所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The failover test job ID. Before calling this operation, use CreateFailoverTestJob to create a job and obtain this ID. If the test resource is an Express Connect circuit, the circuit must be in the Enabled state and its business status must be Normal
parameters.help_zh: 故障演练任务ID。调用前需先使用CreateFailoverTestJob创建任务并获取该ID；当演练资源为物理专线时，该专线必须处于Enabled状态且业务状态为Normal
parameters.name: job_id

JobDuration.description_en: The failover test duration. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1 to 4320

JobType.description_en:
The failover test type. Valid values:

StartNow: start immediately. The test starts immediately after the job is created.

StartLater: start later. Only the test job is created without starting the test
JobType.description_zh:
故障演练类型。取值：

StartNow：立即开始，任务演练任务创建成功后立即开始执行演练。

StartLater：暂不演练，仅创建演练任务暂不执行演练
JobType.title_en:
演练类型。取值：
● StartNow 立即开始
● StartLater 稍后开始

Status.description_en:
The status of the failover test job. Valid values:

Init: pending.

Starting: starting.

Testing: in progress.

Stopping: stopping.

Stopped: completed

Starting：开始中。

Testing：演练中。

Stopping：结束中。

Stopped：已完成
